current_version.source: window.sketch = ({ c2, canvas, startFrame }) => { canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => { canvas.dataset.pointerX = String(event.offsetX); }); const context = canvas.getContext('2d'); startFrame(() => { context.fillStyle = '#1f2937'; context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); context.fillStyle = '#fb7185'; context.beginPath(); context.arc(Number(canvas.dataset.pointerX || 160), 120, 42, 0, Math.PI * 2); context.fill(); }); };

window.sketch = ({ c2, canvas, startFrame }) => { const context = canvas.getContext('2d'); startFrame((frame) => { context.fillStyle = '#111827'; context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); context.fillStyle = '#22d3ee'; context.beginPath(); context.arc(160 + Math.sin(frame / 20) * 40, 120, 42, 0, Math.PI * 2); context.fill(); }); };
